name: @tharros/ads
description: Cerevex ads module — web + api umbrella. Auth and Neon schema os isolated from Brain.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker,inngest -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/ads-api" "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/ads-web" "npm run dev --workspace=@tharros/ads-workers" "npx --yes inngest-cli@latest dev --no-discovery --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43183 -u http://127.0.0.1:43182/api/inngest"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/ads-shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/ads-api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/ads-workers && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shopify-brain/jobs-meta-ads && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shopify-brain/jobs-google-ads && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tharros/ads-web
